bio: If you're looking to explore the Firth of Forth, what better way than with a boat tour? Enjoy views of the Three Bridges, Blackness Castle and more!  This tour with a guided commentary will give you unrivalled views of the iconic Forth Bridges, taking you under Forth Road Bridge, UNESCO World Heritage Forth Bridge and Queensferry Crossing, so you’ll see get to see them like never before.  Take in beautiful sights of Edinburgh’s skyline and the kingdom of Fife as well as Blackness Castle. Keep your eyes peeled on the observation deck as you might spot Scotland popular inhabitants – sea birds and seals! As well as a fun day out soaking up beautiful sights, you’ll be treated to a tasty cream tea on board, comprised of scones with fruit preserve, cream and a choice of tea or coffee.
